title: fix(rest): hand-built write routes withhold the sandbox's own fault as the data door does (#22885)
body:
Fixes #22885
Clause-②: no

## What this does

The QuickJS runner raises some `SandboxError`s itself, with no `innerMessage`: a denied capability, a missing or unavailable `ctx.api` method, a CPU budget or wall-clock ceiling, an install or marshal failure, a nested body's fault relayed one VM hop up. `isSandboxOwnFault` (`@objectstack/types`) recognises them off the producer, and the `/data` door answers them `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` / `Internal server error`. Twenty-three hand-built REST write rows relayed the runner's diagnostic text instead.

- `packages/rest/src/error-response.ts`: `sandboxFaultAnswer` answers `isSandboxOwnFault` with `resolveErrorResponse`, the same classification door and the same withheld `500` it gives a crash. One predicate, one terminal, no own-fault branch anywhere else.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, record-share arms only: `sharingFaultMessage` asks `sandboxFaultAnswer` for its sentence instead of keeping its own sandbox read. The family keeps its own `500 SHARE_*_FAILED` status and code, as it does for a crash (see "The record-share rows" below).
- `packages/rest/src/rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts` §6: nine own-fault shapes, one per kind the runner raises, over every row the ledger already drives (`ANSWERS_THE_SENTENCE`, held to `REST_ROUTE_LEDGER` by §1, not hand-listed). The crash and declared-5xx shapes stay as the CONTROL, unchanged. Each own-fault case asserts the ADR-0112 `status` + `code`, the doors' withheld sentence, no trace of the runner's text in the body, and that the whole `SandboxError` reaches `console.error` (the file now declares `OS_REST_LOG: 'info'` inside §6, as `check:rest-log-spy-declared` requires).
- `.changeset/22885-sandbox-own-fault-rest-write-routes.md`: `@objectstack/rest` `patch`, `Clause-②: no`.

## Measured at RED (the card's "Not measured"), BASE `2e11d9006c`

The new §6 cases, run before the fix: **207 failed / 370 passed**, which is exactly 23 rows x 9 shapes. Every named downstream was called, and no upstream arm (a prefix map, a 403/404 arm, `classifiedRefusalAnswer`) intercepted any shape. Every row reached its own terminal with the runner's text:

| Rows | Status and code at RED |
|---|---|
| `POST /analytics/dataset/query` | `500 ANALYTICS_QUERY_FAILED` |
| `POST /security/explain` | `500 EXPLAIN_FAILED` |
| `POST` / `DELETE /data/:object/:id/shares` | `500 SHARE_GRANT_FAILED` / `SHARE_REVOKE_FAILED` |
| the three sharing-rule writes | `500 RULE_*_FAILED` |
| suggested-binding `confirm` / `dismiss` | `500 SUGGESTION_*_FAILED` |
| the nine `POST /approvals/requests/:id/*` writes | `500 APPROVAL_*_FAILED` |
| `POST /packages/publish` | `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` (text relayed) |
| the four `POST /datasources/:name/external/*` routes | `400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR` / `EXTERNAL_IMPORT_ERROR` |

The other 20 driven rows already answered every shape `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` (the import rows per row inside `200` / `201`), and all 86 control readings already withheld. Before any edit, `sendThrownError` (the classification door) answered all eight runner kinds `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` / `Internal server error`, while `sandboxFaultAnswer` and `classifiedRefusalAnswer` both answered `undefined`. So the change is one line at the function every family already asks.

After: 21 rows answer `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` / `Internal server error`. The two record-share write rows answer `500 SHARE_*_FAILED` / `Internal server error`. `GET /data/:object/:id/shares`, which the write ledger does not drive, was measured by a throwaway probe (deleted): `500 SHARES_LIST_FAILED` / `Internal server error`; the same words on a plain `Error` keep the relayed text there.

## The record-share rows: one reading of the triage text

Triage says the record-share rows "go through the same answer" and "Do not patch their own terminal separately", and also that "The crash rows stay as the CONTROL". The dispatch's reading was that these arms ask `sandboxFaultAnswer` as the other families do. Measured, that literal shape moves the CONTROL: on the two share write rows a crash would go from `500 SHARE_*_FAILED` to `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, and a sandboxed declared 5xx from `500 SHARE_*_FAILED` to `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`, four existing assertions, and it would delete the ledger's `OWN_FAULT_TERMINAL` exception that #22764 recorded as "a decision this card does not take".

So the share arms' sentence is `sandboxFaultAnswer`'s (one predicate, no own-fault check of their own), and their status and code stay their own, exactly as for a crash. `OWN_FAULT_TERMINAL` keeps its two rows; its reason now names the shared read. If the family's status and code should move too, that is a four-line change plus deleting `OWN_FAULT_TERMINAL`, and it moves the crash and declared-5xx answers on these routes with it.

## Files outside the claim's surface, declared

`packages/rest/src/package-routes.ts` and `packages/rest/src/external-datasource-routes.ts`, comment-only. Both docblocks said sentences this change makes false ("`sandboxFaultAnswer` is the doors' answer for exactly those two", "Every other throw keeps this family's own `400`"). No code there changes; both callers already ask `sandboxFaultAnswer` first.

## Reverse verification (one-time; all from committed `24f3dc6f46`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restore proven by blob == HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`)

The tested subjects resolve by relative `src` import, not through a dependency's `exports`, so no `dist` rebuild leg applies.

- **A**, delete the own-fault line in `sandboxFaultAnswer`: anchor 1 to 0, blob `1c91226dfd37` to `aa8e4dc71f19`. Ledger **207 failed / 370 passed**, the RED population exactly (the share rows go red too, since their sentence reads the same answer).
- **B**, delete the share arm's `sandboxFaultAnswer` read: blob `8e11bff9ffa9` to `e31a3df9f2c5`. **18 failed**, only the two record-share write rows (9 shapes each).
- **C**, delete the approvals family's fault-arm `logError`: blob `8e11bff9ffa9` to `96834aaee48f`. **81 failed** (9 approval rows x 9 shapes), each on "the runner's error reaches the server log". The log assertion can fail.

## Tests, at `24f3dc6f46`

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/rest-write-route-hook-refusal-sentence.ledger.test.ts`: 577 passed (189 before this change).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local --maxWorkers=2`: 273 files, 5721 passed, 326 skipped. This includes `sharing-envelope.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project repo --maxWorkers=2`: 5 files, 209 passed, 1 skipped. This includes the three `error-response-*` suites.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0, `check:test-typecheck: OK`. `--listFiles` puts the ledger in the `tsconfig.test.json` program (1 hit).
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` with no paths, on this tree. Reconciled with `--ran`: **65 derived, 64 run at exit 0, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 unrun**.
- **NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`**, reason: exit 3, `PREREQUISITE NOT MET`. 42 packages this diff does not touch have no `dist/` in this container. Narrower reading: `@objectstack/rest` is built and `require('./dist/index.cjs')` loads, with 34 exports. CI runs the full gate.
- Lint, a proven narrowing rather than `pnpm lint`: `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the five touched `.ts` files. ① Population, read from eslint's own config: `--print-config` resolves a config for each of the five (6/6/6/6/5 rules), and the changeset `.md` matches none. ② The JSON result holds 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. ③ Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` sets no `parserOptions.project` and no `projectService` (its own comment: it "never enables type-aware linting"), and this diff touches no config or data file a rule reads, so it cannot move any untouched file's verdict.

## Acceptance notes

- The other `sandboxFaultAnswer` callers in `rest-server.ts` (analytics, explain, sharing rules, suggested bindings, approvals) still describe the answer as "(a crash, or a refusal declaring a 5xx)". That is now incomplete but not false, and it was left alone to keep `rest-server.ts` to the record-share arms. Carrier: none.
- `resolveErrorResponse` asks `isSandboxCrash` at its top but not `isSandboxOwnFault`. An own fault reaches `classifyDataError`'s own-fault terminal only because it carries no `status` or `code`. That holds for every raise site in `quickjs-runner.ts` today (no own-fault construction passes `SandboxErrorInfo`), so it is dormant. Carrier: none.
- The import rows answer an own fault per row with the withheld sentence. This PR adds no log assertion on them, because their contract is a per-row outcome handed to the caller.
